versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הַבָּאִ֤ים אֶל־דָּוִיד֙ לְצִ֣יקְלַ֔ג ע֣וֹד עָצ֔וּר מִפְּנֵ֖י שָׁא֣וּל בֶּן־קִ֑ישׁ וְהֵ֨מָּה֙ בַּגִּבּוֹרִ֔ים עֹזְרֵ֖י הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

controles.web: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
controles.kjv: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
controles.livre: Estes, pois, foram os que vieram a Davi a Ziclague, enquanto ele ainda estava escondido por causa de Saul filho de Quis; e eles estiveram entre os guerreiros que o ajudaram na guerra.

versos.hebraico: נֹ֣שְׁקֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת מַיְמִינִ֤ים וּמַשְׂמִאלִים֙ בָּֽאֲבָנִ֔ים וּבַחִצִּ֖ים בַּקָּ֑שֶׁת מֵאֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל מִבִּנְיָמִֽן׃

controles.web: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow: they were of Saul’s brothers of Benjamin.
controles.kjv: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin.
controles.livre: Eles estavam armados de arcos, e podiam tanto com a mão direita como a esquerda atirar pedras com funda, e setas com arco. Estes eram dentre os irmãos de Saul, os benjamitas.

versos.hebraico: הָרֹ֨אשׁ אֲחִיעֶ֜זֶר וְיוֹאָ֗שׁ בְּנֵי֙ הַשְּׁמָעָ֣ה הַגִּבְעָתִ֔י ויזואל וָפֶ֖לֶט בְּנֵ֣י עַזְמָ֑וֶת וּבְרָכָ֕ה וְיֵה֖וּא הָעֲנְּתֹתִֽי׃

controles.web: The chief was Ahiezer; then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite, and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth, and Beracah, and Jehu the Anathothite,
controles.kjv: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
controles.livre: Aiezer, o cabeça; e Joás, filhos de Semaá o gibeatita; e Jeziel, e Pelete, filhos de Azmavete; e Beraca, e Jeú o anatotita;

versos.hebraico: וְיִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה הַגִּבְעוֹנִ֛י גִּבּ֥וֹר בַּשְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־הַשְּׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
וְיִרְמְיָ֤ה וְיַחֲזִיאֵל֙ וְי֣וֹחָנָ֔ן וְיוֹזָבָ֖ד הַגְּדֵרָתִֽי׃
אֶלְעוּזַ֤י וִירִימוֹת֙ וּבְעַלְיָ֣ה וּשְׁמַרְיָ֔הוּ וּשְׁפַטְיָ֖הוּ החריפי׃

controles.web: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
controles.kjv: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
controles.livre: Eluzai, Jeremote, Bealias, Semarias, e Sefatias o harufita;

versos.hebraico: אֶלְקָנָ֡ה וְ֠יִשִּׁיָּהוּ וַעֲזַרְאֵ֧ל וְיוֹעֶ֛זֶר וְיָשָׁבְעָ֖ם הַקָּרְחִֽים׃

controles.web: Elkanah, and Isshiah, and Azarel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites,
controles.kjv: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
controles.livre: Elcana, Issias, Azareel, Joezer, e Jasobeão, os coraítas;

versos.hebraico: וְיוֹעֵאלָ֧ה וּזְבַדְיָ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְרֹחָ֖ם מִן־הַגְּדֽוֹר׃

controles.web: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
controles.kjv: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
controles.livre: E Joela e Zebadias, filhos de Jeroão de Gedor.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־הַגָּדִ֡י נִבְדְּל֣וּ אֶל־דָּוִיד֩ לַמְצַ֨ד מִדְבָּ֜רָה גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַחַ֗יִל אַנְשֵׁ֤י צָבָא֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עֹרְכֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָרֹ֑מַח וּפְנֵ֤י אַרְיֵה֙ פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְכִצְבָאיִ֥ם עַל־הֶהָרִ֖ים לְמַהֵֽר׃ס

controles.web: Of the Gadites there separated themselves to David to the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, that could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the roes on the mountains;
controles.kjv: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
controles.livre: E alguns dos gaditas passaram a Davi, à fortaleza no deserto, guerreiros valentes, homens de guerra para lutar, armados com escudo e lança; seus rostos eram como rostos de leões, e velozes como as corças sobre os montes.

versos.hebraico: עֵ֖זֶר הָרֹ֑אשׁ עֹבַדְיָה֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֱלִיאָ֖ב הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃

controles.web: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
controles.kjv: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
controles.livre: Ézer o cabeça, Obadias o segundo, Eliabe o terceiro,

versos.hebraico: מִשְׁמַנָּה֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔י יִרְמְיָ֖ה הַחֲמִשִֽׁי׃

controles.web: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
controles.kjv: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
controles.livre: Mismana o quarto, Jeremias o quinto,

versos.hebraico: עַתַּי֙ הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֱלִיאֵ֖ל הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃

controles.web: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
controles.kjv: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
controles.livre: Atai o sexto, Eliel o sétimo,

versos.hebraico: יֽוֹחָנָן֙ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י אֶלְזָבָ֖ד הַתְּשִׁיעִֽי׃

controles.web: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
controles.kjv: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
controles.livre: Joanã o oitavo, Elzabade o nono,

versos.hebraico: יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔יס מַכְבַּנַּ֖י עַשְׁתֵּ֥י עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.
controles.kjv: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
controles.livre: Jeremias o décimo, Macbanai o décimo primeiro.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֥לֶּה מִבְּנֵי־גָ֖ד רָאשֵׁ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א אֶחָ֤ד לְמֵאָה֙ הַקָּטָ֔ן וְהַגָּד֖וֹל לְאָֽלֶף׃

controles.web: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army: he who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.
controles.kjv: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
controles.livre: Estes foram os capitães do exército dos filhos de Gade. O menor tinha autoridade sobre cem homens, e o maior sobre mil.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֤וּ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן וְה֥וּא מְמַלֵּ֖א עַל־כָּל־גדיתיו וַיַּבְרִ֨יחוּ֙ אֶת־כָּל־הָ֣עֲמָקִ֔ים לַמִּזְרָ֖ח וְלַֽמַּעֲרָֽב׃ס

controles.web: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
controles.kjv: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
controles.livre: Estes foram os que passaram o Jordão no mês primeiro, quando ele estava transbordando sobre todas as suas margens; e fizeram fugir a todos os dos vales ao oriente e ao ocidente.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ מִן־בְּנֵ֤י בִנְיָמִן֙ וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה עַד־לַמְצָ֖ד לְדָוִֽיד׃

controles.web: There came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the stronghold to David.
controles.kjv: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
controles.livre: Também alguns dos filhos de Benjamim e de Judá vieram a Davi à fortaleza.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּצֵ֣א דָוִיד֮ לִפְנֵיהֶם֒ וַיַּ֨עַן֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם אִם־לְשָׁל֞וֹם בָּאתֶ֤ם אֵלַי֙ לְעָזְרֵ֔נִי יִֽהְיֶה־לִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם לֵבָ֖ב לְיָ֑חַד וְאִֽם־לְרַמּוֹתַ֣נִי לְצָרַ֗י בְּלֹ֤א חָמָס֙ בְּכַפַּ֔י יֵ֛רֶא אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵ֖ינוּ וְיוֹכַֽח׃ס

controles.web: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart shall be knit to you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”
controles.kjv: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
controles.livre: E Davi saiu ao encontro deles, e lhes falou, dizendo: Se viestes a mim para paz e para me ajudar, meu coração será unido convosco; mas se é para me entregar a meus inimigos, mesmo sendo meus mãos sem crime, o Deus de nossos pais o veja, e o repreenda.

versos.hebraico: וְר֣וּחַ לָבְשָׁ֗ה אֶת־עֲמָשַׂי֮ רֹ֣אשׁ השלושים לְךָ֤ דָוִיד֙ וְעִמְּךָ֣ בֶן־יִשַׁ֔י שָׁל֨וֹם׀ שָׁל֜וֹם לְךָ֗ וְשָׁלוֹם֙ לְעֹ֣זְרֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י עֲזָרְךָ֖ אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וַיְקַבְּלֵ֣ם דָּוִ֔יד וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּרָאשֵׁ֥י הַגְּדֽוּד׃פ

controles.web: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse: peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
controles.kjv: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
controles.livre: Então o Espírito revestiu a Amasai, chefe de trinta, e disse: Teus somos, ó Davi! E contigo estamos, ó filho de Jessé! Paz, paz seja contigo, e paz com os teus ajudadores; pois o teu Deus te ajuda.E Davi os recebeu, e os constituiu entre os capitães das tropas.

versos.hebraico: וּמִֽמְּנַשֶּׁ֞ה נָפְל֣וּ עַל־דָּוִ֗יד בְּבֹא֨וֹ עִם־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֧ים עַל־שָׁא֛וּל לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א עֲזָרֻ֑ם כִּ֣י בְעֵצָ֗ה שִׁלְּחֻ֜הוּ סַרְנֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בְּרָאשֵׁ֕ינוּ יִפּ֖וֹל אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֥יו שָׁאֽוּל׃

controles.web: Of Manasseh also there fell away some to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle; but they didn’t help them; for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will fall away to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”
controles.kjv: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
controles.livre: Também alguns de Manassés passaram a Davi, quando ele veio com os filisteus à batalha contra Saul, ainda que não os ajudaram; porque os líderes dos filisteus, depois de terem feito conselho, o despediram, dizendo: Com nossas cabeças ele passará a seu senhor Saul.

versos.hebraico: בְּלֶכְתּ֣וֹ אֶל־צִֽיקְלַ֗ג נָפְל֣וּ עָלָ֣יו׀ מִֽמְּנַשֶּׁ֡ה עַ֠דְנַח וְיוֹזָבָ֤ד וִידִֽיעֲאֵל֙ וּמִיכָאֵ֣ל וְיוֹזָבָ֔ד וֶאֱלִיה֖וּא וְצִלְּתָ֑י רָאשֵׁ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

controles.web: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.
controles.kjv: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
controles.livre: Quando, pois, ele veio a Ziclague, passaram-se a ele dos de Manassés: Adna, Jozabade, Jediaiel, Micael, Jozabade, Eliú, e Ziletai, chefes de milhares dos de Manassés.

versos.hebraico: וְהֵ֗מָּה עָזְר֤וּ עִם־דָּוִיד֙ עַֽל־הַגְּד֔וּד כִּֽי־גִבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל כֻּלָּ֑ם וַיִּהְי֥וּ שָׂרִ֖ים בַּצָּבָֽא׃

controles.web: They helped David against the band of rovers: for they were all mighty men of valor, and were captains in the army.
controles.kjv: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
controles.livre: E estes ajudaram a Davi contra aquela tropa; porque todos eles eram guerreiros valentes, e foram capitães no exército.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֚י לְעֶת־י֣וֹם בְּי֔וֹם יָבֹ֥אוּ עַל־דָּוִ֖יד לְעָזְר֑וֹ עַד־לְמַחֲנֶ֥ה גָד֖וֹל כְּמַחֲנֵ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

controles.web: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like the army of God.
controles.kjv: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
controles.livre: Pois naquele tempo todos os dias, eles vinham a Davi para o ajudar, até que se fez um grande exército, como um exército de Deus.

versos.hebraico: וְ֠אֵלֶּה מִסְפְּרֵ֞י רָאשֵׁ֤י הֶֽחָלוּץ֙ לַצָּבָ֔א בָּ֥אוּ עַל־דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֑וֹנָה לְהָסֵ֞ב מַלְכ֥וּת שָׁא֛וּל אֵלָ֖יו כְּפִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to Yahweh’s word.
controles.kjv: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.
controles.livre: E este são os números dos chefes armados para a batalha, que vieram a Davi em Hebrom, para passar a ele o reino de Saul, conforme a palavra do SENHOR:

versos.hebraico: בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נֹשְׂאֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָרֹ֑מַח שֵׁ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים וּשְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃ס

controles.web: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, armed for war.
controles.kjv: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Judá que traziam escudo e lança, seis mil e oitocentos, armados para a batalha.

versos.hebraico: מִן־בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן גִּבּ֤וֹרֵי חַ֨יִל֙ לַצָּבָ֔א שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמֵאָֽה׃ס

controles.web: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
controles.kjv: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Simeão, guerreiros valentes para batalhar, sete mil e cem.

versos.hebraico: מִן־בְּנֵי֙ הַלֵּוִ֔י אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
controles.kjv: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Levi, quatro mil e seiscentos;

versos.hebraico: וִיהוֹיָדָ֖ע הַנָּגִ֣יד לְאַהֲרֹ֑ן וְעִמּ֕וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand and seven hundred,
controles.kjv: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
controles.livre: Joiada, porém, era o comandante dos descendentes de Arão, e com ele três mil e setecentos;

versos.hebraico: וְצָד֥וֹק נַ֖עַר גִּבּ֣וֹר חָ֑יִל וּבֵית־אָבִ֥יו שָׂרִ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס

controles.web: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.
controles.kjv: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.
controles.livre: E Zadoque, era um jovem guerreiro valente, e da família de seu pai vinte e dois líderes.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־בְּנֵ֧י בִנְיָמִ֛ן אֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְעַד־הֵ֨נָּה֙ מַרְבִּיתָ֔ם שֹׁמְרִ֕ים מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בֵּ֥ית שָׁאֽוּל׃ס

controles.web: Of the children of Benjamin, the brothers of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.
controles.kjv: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Benjamim, irmãos de Saul, três mil; porque até então ainda havia muitos deles que ainda trabalhavam pela casa de Saul.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁמוֹנֶ֣ה מֵא֑וֹת גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל אַנְשֵׁ֥י שֵׁמ֖וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽם׃ס

controles.web: Of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.
controles.kjv: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Efraim, vinte mil e oitocentos, guerreiros valentes, homens ilustres nas casas de seus pais.

versos.hebraico: וּמֵחֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִקְּבוּ֙ בְּשֵׁמ֔וֹת לָב֖וֹא לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־דָּוִֽיד׃ס

controles.web: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
controles.kjv: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
controles.livre: Da meia tribo de Manassés, dezoito mil, que foram convocados por nome para virem a tornar Davi rei.

versos.hebraico: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֗ר יוֹדְעֵ֤י בִינָה֙ לַֽעִתִּ֔ים לָדַ֖עַת מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רָאשֵׁיהֶ֣ם מָאתַ֔יִם וְכָל־אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־פִּיהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their commandment.
controles.kjv: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Issacar, conhecedores dos tempos, para saberem o que Israel devia fazer, duzentos de seus líderes; e todos os seus irmãos seguiam suas ordens.

versos.hebraico: מִזְּבֻל֞וּן יוֹצְאֵ֣י צָבָ֗א עֹרְכֵ֧י מִלְחָמָ֛ה בְּכָל־כְּלֵ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְלַעֲדֹ֖ר בְּלֹא־לֵ֥ב וָלֵֽב׃ס

controles.web: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array, with all kinds of instruments of war, fifty thousand, and who could command and were not of double heart.
controles.kjv: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
controles.livre: E de Zebulom, cinquenta mil, que saíam como exército preparados para a batalha, com todas as armas de guerra; capazes de batalhar com firmeza de coração.

versos.hebraico: וּמִנַּפְתָּלִ֖י שָׂרִ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְעִמָּהֶם֙ בְּצִנָּ֣ה וַחֲנִ֔ית שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס

controles.web: Of Naphtali one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.
controles.kjv: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
controles.livre: E de Naftali mil capitães, e com eles trinta e sete mil com escudo e lança.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־הַדָּנִי֙ עֹרְכֵ֣י מִלְחָמָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִֽים־וּשְׁמוֹנָ֥ה אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

controles.web: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array, twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
controles.kjv: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
controles.livre: E dos danitas, preparados para a batalha, vinte e oito mil e seiscentos.

versos.hebraico: וּמֵאָשֵׁ֗ר יוֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָ֛א לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ מִלְחָמָ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אָֽלֶף׃ס

controles.web: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array, forty thousand.
controles.kjv: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
controles.livre: E de Aser, dos que saíam como exército, prontos para a batalha, quarenta mil.

versos.hebraico: וּמֵעֵ֣בֶר לַ֠יַּרְדֵּן מִן־הָראוּבֵנִ֨י וְהַגָּדִ֜י וַחֲצִ֣י׀ שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה בְּכֹל֙ כְּלֵי֙ צְבָ֣א מִלְחָמָ֔ה מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃

controles.web: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle, one hundred twenty thousand.
controles.kjv: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
controles.livre: E dalém do Jordão, dos rubenitas, dos gaditas, e da meia tribo de Manassés, como toda variedade de armas de guerra para batalhar, cento e vinte mil.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אֵ֜לֶּה אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִלְחָמָה֮ עֹדְרֵ֣י מַעֲרָכָה֒ בְּלֵבָ֤ב שָׁלֵם֙ בָּ֣אוּ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־דָּוִ֖יד עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠גַם כָּל־שֵׁרִ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לֵ֥ב אֶחָ֖ד לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־דָּוִֽיד׃

controles.web: All these being men of war, who could order the battle array, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
controles.kjv: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
controles.livre: Todos estes homens de guerra, postos em posição de batalha, com coração íntegro, vieram a Hebrom, para constituir Davi rei sobre todo Israel; e também todos os demais de Israel tinham a mesma intenção de constituir Davi o rei.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁ֤ם עִם־דָּוִיד֙ יָמִ֣ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֔ה אֹכְלִ֖ים וְשׁוֹתִ֑ים כִּֽי־הֵכִ֥ינוּ לָהֶ֖ם אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had made preparation for them.
controles.kjv: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
controles.livre: E estiveram ali com Davi três dias, comendo e bebendo, porque seus irmãos haviam lhes feito preparativos.

versos.hebraico: וְגַ֣ם הַקְּרֽוֹבִים־אֲ֠לֵיהֶם עַד־יִשָׂשכָ֨ר וּזְבֻל֜וּן וְנַפְתָּלִ֗י מְבִיאִ֣ים לֶ֡חֶם בַּחֲמוֹרִ֣ים וּבַגְּמַלִּ֣ים וּבַפְּרָדִ֣ים׀ וּֽבַבָּקָ֡ר מַאֲכָ֡ל קֶ֠מַח דְּבֵלִ֨ים וְצִמּוּקִ֧ים וְיַֽיִן־וְשֶׁ֛מֶן וּבָקָ֥ר וְצֹ֖אן לָרֹ֑ב כִּ֥י שִׂמְחָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

controles.web: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, food of meal, cakes of figs, and clusters of raisins, and wine, and oil, and cattle, and sheep in abundance: for there was joy in Israel.
controles.kjv: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.
controles.livre: E também os seus vizinhos, até de Issacar, Zebulom, e Naftali, trouxeram pão sobre asnos, camelos, mulos, e bois; e alimento de farinha, bolos de figos e passas, vinho e azeite, bois e ovelhas em abundância, porque havia alegria em Israel.
